data_binding: contrasts.json primary comparisons; SVG group IDs and exact nominal/lower/upper attributes; Matplotlib axes use those values

encodings.panels: four coffee x exact temperature strata; all 14 primary pairs, native grind labels
encodings.x: delta reported duration, seconds; higher nominal pressure minus lower
encodings.y: delta reported TDS, percentage points; higher nominal pressure minus lower
encodings.extents: conditional perturbation ranges: pair half-width 2*h_tau=1 s horizontally and 2*h_C=0.10 pp vertically at illustration; NOT experimental error bars or sample SDs
encodings.labels: native grinds with callouts; no displacement of data coordinates, including any coincidence
encodings.color: blue both signs strict; brown at least one unresolved; printed ties retained separately in tables
encodings.secondary: excluded from figure; visibly separate four-row table in RESULT and secondary.csv

rights: New numerical comparison of attributable factual values; no source artwork, PDF or facsimile redistribution
ceiling: Condition summaries and conditional signs only; no regression, mechanistic curve, causality or independent validation. PHYSICAL_VALIDATION=NOT_ESTABLISHED.
